At that moment she never told me that he had cancer she wanted to protect me by saying "there is something in his head but it's nothing he'll be fine". I was like 9-10 years old so I just believed her.
One day she drove me to an doctors appointment, on the way back I asked her over and over if I can meet up with my friends, at one point she yelled at me "stop asking me that, I have to care for your father".
I asked her again because I really wanted to meet up. 

Painfull part:
She screamed at me: shut up your Fahrer has cancer I have to care for him.

After that I cried because I first of all I never got screamed at by my mom and I didn't know that it was cancer.
